editorial.blurb: A warm West Loop gem where chef-prepared sushi hits with pristine fish, attentive service, and a cozy-yet-sophisticated vibe that feels elevated but never stuffy.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive around 4pm on a weekday for shorter waits, sit at the bar to watch the chef work their magic, and request handrolls—they'll fill them to the brim with fresh, crispy ingredients.
signatureDishes: Green tea ice cream with Fuji Fu apple cake
